description: Source code for the Dio module in an AUTOSAR platform, implementing digital input/output functions with configuration validation and hardware register access.

methods.name: Dio_ReadPort
methods.description: Reads the level of an entire port after validation.

methods.name: Dio_WritePort
methods.description: Writes a level to an entire port after validation.

methods.name: Dio_ReadChannel
methods.description: Reads the level of a specific channel based on its ID.

methods.name: Dio_WriteChannel
methods.description: Sets or clears a specific channel based on its ID and desired level.

methods.name: Dio_ReadChannelGroup
methods.description: Reads a group of channels defined by a channel group configuration.

methods.name: Dio_WriteChannelGroup
methods.description: Writes a level to a group of channels defined by a channel group configuration.
